patch_description: Combines the stronger concave direct-link preference from the inspiration program with its demand-sensitive two-hop rewards and transit-node pressure discount. Concavity gives moderate-demand links more influence than a purely linear demand reward, while the quadratic terms favor plausible indirect service without overwhelming the direct-link signal. Terms are built only for positive-demand OD pairs, keeping the quadratic count at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\), and the evaluator remains responsible for degree penalties.
